versions.changelog:
Initial release of council-blackboard

- Enables visible OpenClaw–Open WebUI council rooms with typed blackboards and session handovers.
- Fresh blackboard and WebUI room are created for each council session; user receives the chat URL immediately.
- Detailed contribution, validation, and handover rules for robust, auditable model collaboration.
- Configuration via environment variables for workspace and integration settings.
- Supports both OpenClaw-to-WebUI and WebUI-to-OpenClaw workflows with structured board updates.
- Requires independent verification for completion as per blackboard policy.
